description: Eight scanned dogs from Objaverse 1.0 (LVIS category 'dog'), all downloadable and licensed CC-BY, each with its author and page so the attribution travels with the data.

excluded.name: Smoothie-3D upload
excluded.author: wolffiresword
excluded.reason: not an object: a room with its backdrop, 87.9 x 57.1 x 85.1 raw units with two faces of area 42 and surface per bounding volume 0.04 where the dogs measure 0.6-8.9. Normalised to the corpus height it is a wall in front of the sensor, so it is excluded rather than downloaded

excluded.name: Boykin Spaniel
excluded.author: justicar
excluded.reason: untextured: the material carries only a baseColorFactor, so its texture_map.png is the importer's one-pixel grey. The patch then sees a single grey value wherever it looks and hsv carries no information, which is a different experiment from the textured dogs
